metaphors.title: Defensive Retreat
metaphors.paraphrase: England’s retreating formation allowed Argentina to seize momentum and win. The match is used to suggest that passivity in response to AI could make harmful outcomes more likely.
metaphors.style_hint: Draw a football pitch with one team retreating toward its goal as the opposing team advances in waves.
metaphors.district_reason: The opening image comes from a football match and its changing tactics and momentum.

metaphors.title: CERN for AI
metaphors.paraphrase: The author envisions a shared, publicly funded institution that gives researchers access to powerful AI and computing resources. Like a major scientific facility, it would combine expensive infrastructure with organized access for research projects.
metaphors.style_hint: Draw a large research campus with a central computing hall, connected laboratories, and researchers entering through a shared public gateway.
metaphors.district_reason: The proposal compares public AI research infrastructure to CERN, a large, purpose-built scientific institution.

metaphors.title: Knowledge Digestion
metaphors.paraphrase: A proof is most valuable not merely when produced, but when its ideas are absorbed into the community’s shared understanding. AI’s speed may outpace that process of assimilation.
metaphors.style_hint: Draw a theorem passing through a symbolic digestive system and becoming part of a shared brain or body made of interconnected researchers.
metaphors.district_reason: The image of a theorem being digested draws on bodily digestion to describe knowledge becoming assimilated.
